metadata.title: Lamborghini Official NHTSA & Safety Recall Intelligence Registry

critical_active_campaigns.defect_summary: Software defect causes backup camera image to fail to display on instrument cluster when shifting into reverse, violating FMVSS 111.
critical_active_campaigns.consequence: Reduced driver visibility increases risk of collision or pedestrian injury when reversing.
critical_active_campaigns.remedy: Authorized dealers update rearview camera software free of charge via factory diagnostic terminal.

critical_active_campaigns.component: Scissor Door Gas Strut Spherical Support Pins
critical_active_campaigns.defect_summary: Gas springs holding the scissor doors open may disconnect due to improperly assembled spherical support pins.
critical_active_campaigns.consequence: The heavy scissor door could unexpectedly shut, creating injury risk to occupants entering or exiting.
critical_active_campaigns.remedy: Dealers inspect and tighten spherical support pins to certified torque specifications.

critical_active_campaigns.component: Engine Oil Circuit Connection Flange Screws
critical_active_campaigns.defect_summary: Improper torque on oil line connection flange from the radiator to oil tank can lead to oil leakage.
critical_active_campaigns.consequence: Leaked oil contacting hot exhaust components increases the hazard of engine compartment fire.
critical_active_campaigns.remedy: Dealers inspect and retorque flange screws or replace affected seal gaskets.

critical_active_campaigns.component: Fuel Line Quick Connector & High-Pressure Pump
critical_active_campaigns.defect_summary: Engine compartment heat can cause quick-connect fuel line fittings to soften and seep fuel vapor/liquid.
critical_active_campaigns.consequence: Fuel smell in cabin and elevated fire danger in extreme hot climates.
critical_active_campaigns.remedy: Dealers replace fuel line assembly with updated heat-shielded connector free of charge.

critical_active_campaigns.component: Fuel System / EVAP Purge Canister Overflow
critical_active_campaigns.defect_summary: Under certain driving conditions (overfilling tank and aggressive deceleration), raw fuel enters EVAP system.
critical_active_campaigns.consequence: Vapor contacts hot exhaust gases, creating tailpipe flames that can ignite rear bumper plastic and carbon diffuser.
critical_active_campaigns.remedy: Dealers install upgraded fuel tank EVAP purge valve with secondary roll-over protection.

critical_active_campaigns.component: Front Suspension Upper Control Arm Camber Bolts
critical_active_campaigns.defect_summary: Camber adjustment bolts may not have been torqued to factory specifications, allowing alignment slippage.
critical_active_campaigns.consequence: Sudden change in front wheel camber under high lateral load impairs steering control.
critical_active_campaigns.remedy: Dealers inspect and replace camber adjustment bolts with hardened fasteners torqued to revised spec.
